en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a broad tree-lined street in an urban setting. Many men and boys sit or crouch along the sidewalk providing shoe-shine services (bootblacks), while pedestrians walk along the street. On the right there is a decorative metal fence and buildings with arched windows and palm trees inside the compound. Bare trees arch over the road, suggesting winter or early spring. Printed caption text appears at the bottom.
